items.title: Still work to do for Kelly Oubre, but better today on offense thanks to some cutting/slashing. Four makes, mostly right at the cup. On the bad side, three fouls already and out he goes for Jarace Walker, who has behind Oubre and Jalen Slawson in the rotation before the fouls.

items.title: Big ups to Jalen Slawson. Guy has battled all night when given a chance. Just got a steal, then Haliburton lobbed it to Toppin on the break. Pacers still down 16 with 4:55 to go. Basically out of time.

quote.text: The boos keep getting rightly loudner. Another turnover, the Pacers seventh of this quarter, and the Mavs easily beat them up the floor for a basket. Dallas is up 30. Pacers look stunned.

items.title: Obi Toppin was warming up, then Rick Carlisle walked over and said something to him and he went back to the locker room. Carlisle then chatted with Jalen Slawson, who removed his wamrups. Looks like it will be no more starters + Toppin. Slawson-Sheppard-Walker-QJackson-Huff now.
